title: VIO to MAVLink bridge with ENU/FLU to NED/FRD conversion
summary: Sends an external pose source (VIO topic or CSV log) to PX4 EKF2 or ArduPilot EKF3 as VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE or ODOMETRY for GPS-denied position hold. The frame conversion (ENU/FLU to NED/FRD, world to body velocity, MAVLink covariance layout) is a stdlib module with unit tests, and the pymavlink sender plus small set_params / watch_ekf helpers sit on top.
verified: Ran on 2026-11-06: frames.py tests (8 OK) and --dry-run on python3.14.7; the pymavlink ODOMETRY path ran against ArduCopter 4.6.3 SITL (EKF3 'is using external nav data', flags 0x033f) and PX4 v1.17.0 SIH (estimator_status_flags cs_ev_pos/cs_ev_hgt/cs_ev_yaw/cs_ev_vel True), both in Docker from samples/sitl-docker with pymavlink 2.4.50. Only a stationary pose was streamed; no flight on vision was tested. --msg vpe not run.
